connecticut-families-facing-housing-chal.core: Posted in last 7 days Connecticut Families Facing Housing Challenges - Policy Change The Parent Leaders of the CT Parent Housing Table want to shine light on the experiences of Connecticut families facing housing challenges and bring those lived experiences into the public policy conversation. We are inviting Connecticut residents who have experienced challenges securing affordable, safe, and stable housing or accessing housing assistance to share their stories by responding to a series of interview questions. Stories will be compiled into video segments and shared with the broader community, elected officials, and housing leaders across Connecticut ahead of November’s elections. The goal is to help policymakers hear directly from residents, so they can better understand the real-life impact of Connecticut’s housing systems, and consider opportunities for change. We want to hear not only about the challenges you experienced, but also what could have been different. What policies, programs, resources, or other changes could have made it easier for you and your family to access housing or the assistance you needed? Participants will receive interview questions, recording guidelines, and helpful tips to make sharing your story as easy and comfortable as possible. Your experience matters. Your voice matters. Your story can help shape the conversation about housing in Connecticut. By bringing lived experiences directly into the conversation, we hope this project will inform community dialogue and contribute to legislative discussions and decisions during the 2027 legislative session. If you or someone you know would like to participate, please complete the form below. Once you sign up, you’ll receive information about next steps, recording guidance, and project @updates. To find out more about the CT Parent Housing Table (click here) https://lnkd.in/g2hmD846 To Sign up to record a video : https://lnkd.in/gGjGVDCD

indian-consumers-and-auto-dealers-jati-n.core: Posted in last 7 days Indian Consumers & Auto Dealers - Jati Networks & Vehicle Choices Seeking Indian perspectives on community networks and consumer choices I’m conducting research on how jati-based community networks in India share purchasing advice and recommendations through platforms such as WhatsApp—and how these exchanges may influence consumer choices, particularly vehicle purchases. I’d love to speak with Indian consumers, automobile dealers, and researchers or industry professionals who can share relevant experiences or perspectives. I’m also interested in whether digital communication is changing these networks and how businesses engage with them. Experiences where these networks have little or no influence are equally welcome. You can participate through: • A short written interview, completed at your convenience • A 20–30-minute video interview Responses will inform the newsletter, and I will confirm your permission and preferred attribution before quoting you. If you’re interested—or know someone who might be—please send me a DM. #India #ConsumerInsights #Automotive #CommunityNetworks
